traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Hymenophyllaceae: the filmy ferns, mostly epiphytic, on slender creeping rhizomes without scales; fronds 5 mm to 60 cm, the blade one cell thick, without stomata; sporangia on receptacles that continue the vein tips at the margin, in tubular or two-lipped indusia.
